summary.text: Mike Finn is a Democratic state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 6th Hampden District since 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as court officer with the Trial Court of Massachusetts, and he chairs the Joint Committee on Bonding, Capital Expenditures, and State Assets.

paragraphs.text: Michael Finn attended North Adams State College, and his professional experience includes working as a court officer for the Trial Court of Massachusetts.
He assumed office in the 6th Hampden District in 2011, and Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Joint Committee on Bonding, Capital Expenditures, and State Assets for 2025-2026 and 2023-2024.

Earlier, according to Ballotpedia, he was House chair of the Children, Families and Persons with Disabilities Joint Committee (2021-2022) and chair of the House Global Warming and Climate Change Committee (2019-2020).
